props.name: label
props.description: The control's name, shown beside it.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Validation text, shown only while in error.

props.name: error
props.description: Whether the field is in its error state.

slots.name: control
slots.description: The wrapped control: a checkbox, a radio, a text input.

accessibility.describes: aria-describedby → description, plus error while shown

behavior.text: clicking the label focuses the control and forwards the click, as a native label does; inert while the control is disabled.
the control is named by the label and described by the description, plus the error message while shown.
error mounts the error message and asks the control to expose aria-invalid; announcing it is the application's policy.
the first field-aware control inside the field is the one it labels; a nested field scopes to its own subtree.
